style_rules.display: Locally packaged Instrument Serif 400 upright and italic, at minus .025em tracking. Source Sans 3 for UI/body; existing Source Serif 4 retained for reading prose. No synthesized Instrument weights.
style_rules.hero: Indigo #243BA5; warm-white text #FAF7EE, secondary #D9DEF2 and quiet citron #DBE6AE. Display title6.5rem to12rem, phone4rem to7.8rem with responsive320px adjustment.
style_rules.student: Pale sage #E6E8D4 with #242B45 text and #4F5A63 secondary text. Dark slate-blue and olive contour lines replace bright green/cyan strokes.
style_rules.reading: Warm paper #F4F1E8 with off-white #FCFAF4 surfaces and neutral #E9E7DD accents; main ink #22283F and secondary #596172.
style_rules.manifesto: Dark navy #1E263F, warm-white headings #FAF7EE, secondary #D7DBEE and italic accent #DBE6AE.
style_rules.opening: Same warm paper as reading sections; first name Source Sans 3 550 with minus .055em tracking, surname Instrument Serif italic400 at minus .025em tracking. Existing2.6second masked/shutter sequence preserved.
style_rules.details: Hero role, availability, study and control text enlarged; desktop labels .875rem to.9rem, phone .8rem to.82rem. Decorative footer sentence hidden on phones; interactive controls retained.
style_rules.graphics: Existing original atlas geometry at72percent CSS opacity, pointer response and motion preferences unchanged.
style_rules.font_source: Instrument Serif library entry google-instrumentserif; verified unmodified TTFs, pinned Google Fonts commit67bc647ce1910e92f461bcc82aae30f21d21a9cc, full OFL notice retained. Fonts are project-packaged; no global path or runtime external request.
